scripts.//: Every delegating script ends in `--`. Without it, `npm run test -- --ci` expands to `npm run test --workspace apps/web --ci`, and npm eats `--ci` as one of its own CLI flags instead of forwarding it to jest — the step still exits 0, having silently run without the flag. The trailing `--` makes the expansion `... --workspace apps/web -- --ci`, which forwards. Same trap for `npm run e2e -- --list`, which otherwise runs the entire suite.
scripts.//test:platform: Monorepo-level tests, run from the root — they assert properties of the repository itself (which workflows may reach production, which packages are wired in) rather than of the application. It goes through a runner rather than `node --test <glob>` because glob support in the test runner is Node 22 and CI pins Node 20; see tools/run-platform-tests.mjs.
scripts.//generate: The three generated artifacts, regenerated together. Run this BEFORE test:platform, never after: the platform suite checks that what is committed matches what the sources now say, so generating after verifying produces a file that was current when written and stale when pushed. That has now happened twice — once at commit time (fixed by counting untracked files) and once by editing the ledger after regenerating. This script exists so the order is a command rather than something to remember.
scripts.generate: node tools/document-graph.mjs && node tools/platform-truth.mjs && node tools/ownership-map.mjs && node tools/entry-point-inventory.mjs && node tools/duplicate-sources-doc.mjs && node tools/contract-schemas.mjs && node tools/reconcile-execution-checkboxes.mjs
scripts.//verify: What to run before pushing anything that touches the app or the ledger.
scripts.verify: npm run generate && npm run type-check && npm run test -- --ci && npm run test:platform
scripts.//loop: The autonomous loop. Rules in docs/implementation/AUTONOMOUS-LOOP.md; both scripts derive their answers from the ledger and the execution prompt, so a new session needs no memory of the last one.
scripts.db:migrate: npm exec --workspace apps/web -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.//studio: The internal console. Separate app because it shows every tenant configuration and must not share an origin with any one tenant (PD-007).
